question: Is score_variant additive over simultaneous mutations (allowing batching to save model calls)?
method: Compared score_variant 'A16V:I10V:S5T' against the sum of the three single-mutant scores, same WT sequence MRKLSDELLIESYFKATEMNLNRDFIELIENEIKRRSLGHIISV.
conclusion: NOT exactly additive: masking multiple positions alters each position's context, so masked-marginal deltas are mask-pattern-dependent. Batching is therefore an approximation with small (~0.04) but nonzero error; individual scoring is the clean approach for exact per-mutant ranks.
limitations: Error magnitude was only probed for one 3-mutation batch; error likely grows with batch size and positional proximity.
execution_evidence: run_model score_variant calls x4 (models asset esm2_variant, facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D pinned)

question: Which single mutants are predicted most tolerated by ESM-2 masked-marginal delta log-likelihood?
method: run_model score_variant individually for 86 conservative single mutants (2 per position across all 44 positions of MRKLSDELLIESYFKATEMNLNRDFIELIENEIKRRSLGHIISV); each = masked-marginal delta log-likelihood (higher = more tolerated, E1).
conclusion: ESM-2 predicts the most tolerated substitutions are I29L, M19L, N22D, R2K, R23K, F14L (all >+1.0). Note N22D is a polar->negatively-charged change, not conservative.

question: Do ESM-2 top-ranked mutants have high measured fitness (round 1)?
method: query_evidence_oracle on top-10 E1 candidates (ProteinGym SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0 historical measurements).
conclusion: E1 ranking is positively but weakly correlated with measured fitness. 6/10 top-E1 candidates have positive measured fitness. Best measured = I41L (+0.313). High-E1 but non-conservative-context picks R2K, R23K, F14L, H40R FAILED (negative). Positions with measured-positive mutants: 14, 19, 22, 29, 39, 41.
limitations: Measurement scale unknown; top-quartile threshold (~75th pct of 834-pool) not yet established.

question: Do conservative substitutions at mutation-tolerant positions give the highest measured fitness (round 2)?
method: query_evidence_oracle on 10 round-2 candidates (new high-E1 + previously-scored unmeasured).
conclusion: Strong support for H2: conservative substitutions at tolerant positions succeed (S12A +0.467 best; D24E +0.136; G39T +0.134). High-E1 but non-conservative/charge-changed variants FAILED (N22E, G39N, F14I, H40Q all negative despite E1>1.1 for E/G/I). ESM-2 E1 alone has weak precision; combining E1 with conservation+tolerant-position prior is far better.
limitations: All queries biased to high-E1; no unbiased distribution sample, so top-quartile threshold unmeasured.
execution_evidence: 10 query_evidence_oracle calls (historical E3, SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0); 27 further score_variant E1 calls

question: Round-3 confirmatory measurements at the best position (12) and neighbors (42, 44).
method: query_evidence_oracle on S12T, S12V, I42L, V44L (final 4 of 24 budget).
conclusion: Position 12 is the highest-fitness locus in the pool: S12T (+0.513) > S12V (+0.484) > S12A (+0.467). S->T/V/A all strongly positive. I42L failed despite adjacency to the successful I41L (position-specific, not region-wide).
limitations: Position 12 substitutions dominate the sampled top; other unexplored positions could harbor mutants of comparable fitness but remain UNOBSERVED within budget.
execution_evidence: 4 query_evidence_oracle calls (historical E3, SDA_BACSU_Tsuboyama_2023_1PV0); total 24/24 oracle, 120/120 model calls

question: Which 5 mutants are most likely to have the highest MEASURED fitness?
method: Combine all 24 E3 measurements with 120 E1 scores under H1/H2. Final ranking uses MEASURED values where available (E3); E1 used only to prioritize which to measure.
conclusion: The 5 highest MEASURED-fitness mutants observed are S12T, S12V, S12A, I41L, T17V (all E3, values +0.29 to +0.51). ESM-2 E1 alone was weakly precise (high-E1 N22E/G39N/F14I/H40Q/H40R all measured negative); combining E1 with a conservation-at-tolerant-position prior drove selection. Final answer = these 5 measured winners.
limitations: Only 24/834 candidates measured, biased toward high-E1 and position-12; true top-quartile threshold never directly estimated (no unbiased sample). These 5 are strongly positive on the measured scale but this is an E3-supported conclusion, not a guarantee about the unmeasured 810; E1 scores are predictions (E1), never measurements. No structure/energetic model used.
execution_evidence: 24 query_evidence_oracle E3 calls; 120 run_model score_variant E1 calls; records ev-1..ev-4
